gloss: single item; a la carte; individual product

definitions.gloss: single item, a la carte, individual product
definitions.explanation: An individual item sold or ordered separately, not as part of a set, combo, or bundle. Commonly used in restaurants and retail contexts.

examples.japanese: {単品|たんぴん}で{注文|ちゅうもん}できますか。
examples.english: Can I order it a la carte?

examples.japanese: セットより{単品|たんぴん}のほうが{高|たか}い。
examples.english: Ordering individually is more expensive than the set.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{単品|たんぴん}でも{販売|はんばい}していますが、まとめ{買|が}いのほうがお{得|とく}です。
examples.english: This product is sold individually, but buying in bulk is a better deal.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{単品|たんぴん}で{注文|ちゅうもん}する (order a la carte)
・{単品|たんぴん}{価格|かかく} (individual item price)
・{単品|たんぴん}{販売|はんばい} (selling items individually)

USAGE NOTES:
In restaurants, {単品|たんぴん} means ordering dishes individually rather than as a set meal (セット or {定食|ていしょく}). In retail, it means purchasing a product on its own rather than as part of a bundle or pack. Contrasts with セット (set/combo) and まとめ{買|が}い (bulk purchase).
